messages:
ivy: hi team, opening my first PR against the proxy-service. Quick onboarding questions: do we require signed commits (GPG)? also the integration tests in CI need a small dataset and a SERVICE_ACCOUNT key  how do I run those locally? should I make a draft PR first?

jordan: welcome! No mandatory GPG signing for first-timers, but we do encourage `git commit -s` for traceability. For integration tests run `./scripts/bootstrap-integration.sh` which drops a tiny test fixture into `tests/fixtures/` and sets `export SERVICE_ACCOUNT=$(cat ~/keys/test-sa.json)` then `make test-integration`.

ivy: bootstrapping script needs AWS creds I don't have. Who can grant access for onboarding keys?

priya: ping @devops and ask for an `onboarding-temp-key`. We usually issue short-lived creds and rotate them. If you can't get creds, run `make test-integration-mini` which skips external calls and uses a recorded fixture.

jordan: PR process: use `feature/onb-<ticket>-desc` naming, open as draft if WIP. We squash on merge, include a one-line changelog in `changelogs/unreleased.md`, and fill the PR template's "why" section with a short justification.

ivy: where do I add tests? small unit in `tests/unit/` and integration in `tests/integration/`?

priya: yep. Unit tests for logic go in `tests/unit/`, integration/instrumentation in `tests/integration/`. Add a small fixture in `tests/fixtures/` and reference it from the test. Keep integration runtimes mocked if possible.

jordan: reviewers: CODEOWNERS will auto-request reviewers. If it touches routing/kernel selection ping @jordan or @infra-leads directly. We aim for one human approver + passing CI. If it's your first contribution add `first-time-contributor` label.

devops-bot: FYI: onboarding keys expire in 72 hours. Use `devops request-key --onboarding` and include your GitHub handle. See /docs/onboarding/keys for the process.

ivy: great, thanks. Any PR size limits? I can split this into two PRs but not sure where to cut.

priya: prefer PRs that are <250 LOC and address one concern. If it's refactor + feature, split refactor first, then feature. Use a minimal CHANGELOG entry per PR.

ivy: will do. creating draft PR and running `make test-integration-mini` now, pinging @jordan when ready. thanks all :pray:
